# Co-written 0.3.0
- A succinct menu-bar dropdown: icons, short feature labels and cue counts on one page. Its height adapts to the findings. Expand into the full app for evidence and detailed advice. - Liquid Glass controls on macOS 26+, system colours and light/dark appearance, with native material fallbacks on older Macs. Readable content surfaces keep the writing clear. - Open the full app to analyse mouse selections in other apps automatically. Closing, hiding or minimising its window stops selection watching and pending AI work; menu-bar-only operation still uses **⇧⌘L**. - AI stays enabled by default with your own saved key and sharing permission. Mouse-triggered requests wait for stable selections and are spaced by at least 15 seconds. Explicit shortcut requests and retries remain responsive. - Start silently in the menu bar. Settings and the full window open only when requested, and saved windows are not restored. - Signed and notarised universal macOS app, DMG and verified Sparkle delta updates.
AI reviews send the requested or settled highlighted passage to your configured provider and may incur API charges. Each user supplies their own key, stored in Keychain. Turn off AI for local analysis. Style cues, including Humanizer patterns, cannot establish authorship. Live OpenAI calls remain unverified without a saved key; regression checks use mock responses.

# Co-written 0.2.2
- Start silently with only the menu-bar icon, including the first launch and login startup. - Settings and the detailed view open only when explicitly requested. Remove the automatic first-run popup and prevent previously open windows from being restored after a restart. - Keep shortcut-only selection analysis and default AI for requested reviews. - Signed and notarised universal macOS app, packaged in a DMG with signed Sparkle delta updates.

# Co-written 0.2.1
- Selection analysis runs only when you press **⇧⌘L**. The background watcher is removed, including for upgrades with old automatic-analysis settings. Clicking the menu-bar icon only opens the dropdown. - AI stays on by default for requested analyses when your own key and sharing permission are configured. Saving credentials or changing settings never sends an existing passage. Paste and macOS Services remain explicit ways to supply text. - More reliable AI reviews for short passages: concise bounded output, a larger reply budget, and individual unverified quotations omitted with a visible note instead of rejecting the whole review. - Clear error messages for unfinished, truncated, filtered, refused and malformed AI replies; explicit retries work. Local analysis remains available. - Signed and notarised universal macOS app, packaged in a DMG with signed Sparkle delta updates.
Each downloader supplies their own OpenAI key, stored in their Mac’s Keychain. Requested AI reviews send the passage to the configured provider and may incur API charges. No shared key is bundled. Provider retention rules apply. Automated validation uses mocked replies; a real OpenAI call could not be tested without a saved key.
